heading: Products I've helped bring to life.

items.title: SlamSport AI
items.shortDescription: A modern AI-powered sports intelligence platform that transforms athlete data into actionable insights for performance, scouting, recruiting, and player development.
items.description: SlamSport AI is a comprehensive sports intelligence platform designed for athletes, coaches, teams, and sports organizations. I independently developed the frontend, translating the product vision and visual designs into an engaging, responsive, and user-friendly digital experience. The website presents complex capabilities—including performance intelligence, competitive analysis, scouting, injury prevention, and athlete development—through clear content structures, immersive visuals, and intuitive navigation.
items.problem: Sports performance, health, scouting, and recruiting information is often fragmented across different systems, making it difficult for athletes and organizations to understand the complete picture. The frontend needed to communicate a sophisticated AI-driven product clearly while supporting multiple audiences, content-rich pages, and a strong sports-focused visual identity.
items.solution: I developed a responsive, visually engaging frontend that organizes the platform’s complex capabilities into easily understandable sections and user journeys. I created reusable interface components, structured navigation, interactive content areas, responsive layouts, and prominent calls to action while maintaining a consistent brand experience across the website.
items.architecture: The frontend follows a reusable, component-based architecture with shared navigation, page sections, content cards, forms, calls to action, and footer components. Pages are organized around the platform’s primary audiences and capabilities, enabling consistent presentation, easier maintenance, and scalable addition of new sports, solutions, resources, and product modules.
items.results: Delivered a production-ready, responsive frontend that establishes a strong digital presence for SlamSport AI and clearly communicates its value to athletes, coaches, teams, and organizations. The completed website transforms a complex sports-technology offering into an accessible experience that supports product discovery, brand credibility, and demo-generation goals.

items.title: Online Resume Maker
items.shortDescription: A user-friendly online resume builder that helps job seekers create professional, print-ready resumes through customizable templates and a streamlined editing experience.
items.description: Online Resume Maker is a comprehensive career tool designed to simplify professional resume creation. I independently developed the frontend, transforming the product requirements and designs into a responsive, intuitive, and engaging web experience. The platform enables job seekers to explore industry-specific, creative, modern, and professional templates before building a polished resume through an accessible, step-by-step workflow.
items.problem: Creating a polished resume can be time-consuming and technically challenging, particularly for job seekers without design experience. Users needed a straightforward platform where they could discover suitable templates, enter their professional information, and produce a well-structured resume without working with complicated document-design software.
items.solution: I developed an intuitive and responsive frontend that guides users from template discovery to resume completion. The experience combines categorized template browsing, clear navigation, structured data-entry interfaces, responsive layouts, and print-ready presentation to make resume creation approachable for users with different levels of technical experience.
items.architecture: The frontend was structured around reusable components for template galleries, category navigation, resume sections, form controls, content previews, calls to action, informational sections, and responsive layouts. This modular approach maintains visual consistency across the platform and makes it easier to expand the template library and resume-building experience.
keyFeatures: Use Manual template generator to prepare CV
challenges: AI integration for auto CV generation
items.results: Delivered a production-ready resume-building experience that turns a traditionally complex document-creation process into a clear and accessible workflow. The platform provides job seekers with a convenient way to explore professional designs, organize their career information, and create polished resumes suitable for printing and job applications.

items.title: Vitasoftware SaaS Platform
items.shortDescription: A modern SaaS platform that helps businesses explore, compare, and subscribe to tailored web, mobile, marketing, and design solutions through transparent service packages.
items.description: Vitasoftware is a subscription-based digital services platform created for businesses seeking scalable web development, mobile applications, digital marketing, and graphic design solutions. I independently developed full application, transforming the platform’s business requirements into a polished, responsive, and conversion-focused user experience. The interface enables customers to explore services, compare pricing packages, understand included features, and schedule a consultation through a clear and engaging journey.
items.problem: Businesses often struggle to understand the scope, pricing, and technical differences between digital service packages. Vitasoftware required a frontend capable of presenting several service categories, subscription plans, detailed feature comparisons, FAQs, and consultation options without overwhelming potential customers.
items.solution: I developed a responsive and conversion-oriented frontend that organizes complex service information into an intuitive experience. Interactive service selection, structured pricing cards, detailed comparison tables, contextual FAQs, and prominent calls to action help customers identify the package that best matches their requirements.
items.architecture: The frontend follows a modular, component-based structure with reusable components for service selectors, pricing cards, feature-comparison tables, consultation sections, FAQ groups, navigation, and calls to action. Service and package information is presented through a consistent data-driven interface, making the platform easier to maintain and expand with additional plans or offerings.
keyFeatures: Purchase subscription and get services for 2 Years
items.results: Delivered a production-ready frontend that transforms a broad range of digital services into a structured and approachable customer journey. The platform strengthens Vitasoftware’s professional online presence while making it easier for potential clients to compare plans, understand available services, and move confidently toward consultation or subscription.

items.title: Pay the Debt Coin
items.shortDescription: A Web3 platform for an Ethereum-based meme coin that clearly presents its mission, tokenomics, deflationary model, contract details, and publicly verifiable on-chain information.
items.description: Pay the Debt Coin is a mission-driven cryptocurrency platform built around an Ethereum ERC-20 token. I independently developed the frontend, transforming detailed blockchain concepts into an engaging and accessible digital experience. The website introduces the project’s purpose while providing structured access to its tokenomics, burn mechanism, public wallet addresses, whitepaper, contract review, risk disclosures, and token acquisition journey.

image.alt: Pay the Debt Coin platform screenshot

items.problem: Cryptocurrency projects frequently present complex token mechanics, smart-contract information, wallet activity, and risk factors that can be difficult for nontechnical users to understand. The project needed a frontend that could capture attention while communicating its purpose, token model, transparency commitments, and associated risks clearly and responsibly.
items.solution: I developed a responsive, content-focused frontend that organizes technical and project information into an approachable user journey. Clear navigation, structured tokenomics, prominent calls to action, readable documentation, contract references, wallet information, and risk disclosures help visitors understand the project and independently verify its public blockchain data.
items.architecture: The frontend uses a modular page structure with reusable navigation, informational sections, tokenomics displays, calls to action, documentation layouts, risk notices, and external blockchain references. Dedicated pages separate the whitepaper and contract review from the primary marketing experience, allowing detailed technical information to remain accessible without overwhelming first-time visitors.
keyFeatures: User can purchase PTDC token and can sale when currency lunches
items.results: Delivered a production-ready Web3 frontend that gives the project a distinctive digital identity while making its mission and token mechanics easier to understand. The website balances promotional storytelling with detailed documentation and transparent access to contract, wallet, token-allocation, and risk information.

items.title: Mettaswap
items.shortDescription: A decentralized token-swapping application that provides users with a focused, intuitive interface for exchanging digital assets through a modern Web3 experience.
items.description: Mettaswap is a decentralized Web3 application designed to make token exchange more accessible through a clean and streamlined interface. I independently developed the frontend, translating blockchain-based trading requirements into an intuitive user experience. The application presents token selection, exchange amounts, swap details, and transaction actions through a focused interface that helps users navigate the swapping process with confidence.
items.problem: Decentralized exchanges can be difficult for new users because they combine unfamiliar wallet interactions, token selection, exchange values, and blockchain transaction states. Mettaswap required a frontend that could simplify this technical workflow while preserving the speed, transparency, and control expected from a decentralized application.
items.solution: I developed a responsive and interaction-focused frontend that transforms the token-swapping process into a clear sequence of actions. The interface organizes token selection, amount entry, exchange information, wallet-related actions, validation feedback, and transaction states into a cohesive experience designed for both desktop and mobile users.
items.architecture: The frontend follows a component-based dApp architecture with reusable elements for token selectors, amount inputs, swap controls, wallet actions, transaction summaries, loading states, validation messages, and responsive layouts. Application state is organized around the active tokens, entered amounts, wallet status, and transaction lifecycle to keep the interface synchronized with user actions.
keyFeatures: User can swap old tokens with new tokens without any extra charges

items.title: Delivery Fleet
items.shortDescription: A secure multi-tenant delivery fleet management system for managing vehicles, drivers, customer contracts, assignments, orders, expenses, and operational performance.
items.description: Delivery Fleet is a multi-tenant fleet management platform designed for companies providing delivery services to hotels and restaurants. I developed the frontend dashboard for managing the complete operational workflow, including drivers, vehicles, customer contracts, car-driver assignments, orders, employees, expenses, revenue, maintenance, mileage, and accidents. The system provides each authorized user with a focused experience based on their assigned company, branch, role, and permissions.
items.problem: Delivery fleet companies often manage drivers, vehicles, customer contracts, assignments, orders, and financial records through disconnected tools or manual processes. This makes it difficult to control data access, monitor daily operations, track profitability, and ensure that users only access the information and screens relevant to their responsibilities.
items.solution: I developed a centralized and responsive administration dashboard that allows fleet companies to manage their operational data from one place. The system supports role-based access control, permission-based navigation, company and branch-level data isolation, customer contract management, car-driver pairing, customer assignments, and real-time operational summaries. Each super administrator can access only their own company’s data, while other users see only the modules and actions permitted by their assigned roles.
items.architecture: The platform follows a secure multi-tenant architecture built with NestJS and React.js. Tenant data is isolated using companyId and branchId across protected operations, ensuring that records remain within the correct organizational boundary. Role-based access control governs module, screen, and action permissions, while reusable frontend modules support dashboards, vehicles, drivers, assignments, customers, contracts, orders, employees, expenses, maintenance, mileage, and accident management.
items.results: Delivered a centralized fleet operations platform that gives administrators clear visibility into drivers, vehicles, customers, active and expired contracts, assignments, orders, revenue, expenses, and net profit. The system replaces fragmented operational processes with a secure, structured, and scalable workflow while supporting multiple fleet companies and branches within a single platform.
